swift-test-fixed-sleep.whyNotLinter: SwiftLint has no test-sleep rule; a `custom_rules` regex could ban `Thread.sleep` in tests but not tell a latency-simulating fake from a wait.
swift-test-fixed-sleep.aiRelevance: Agents converting completion-handler code to tests reach for `Thread.sleep`/`Task.sleep` to 'let the task finish'.

swift-test-error-path-passes-silently.whyNotLinter: SwiftLint has no rule for this; it needs to know the test's intent (expects an error) and that the success path records no failure.
swift-test-error-path-passes-silently.aiRelevance: Agents port try/catch habits from other languages into XCTest; Banik et al. list 'exception-free' and missing-oracle patterns as common in agent tests.
swift-test-error-path-passes-silently.notes: swift_testing_async is a weak fit; the Swift Testing 'Testing for errors' article would be the proper B source (not fetched).

swift-test-unawaited-task.whyNotLinter: Swift 6 concurrency checking does not flag an unawaited `Task {}`; whether assertions depend on it needs judgment.
